question:
(i) Define fringe width in Young's double-slit experiment.
(ii) Write its expression in terms of $\lambda$, $D$ and $d$.

options.A:
(i) Fringe width is the distance between a bright and the adjacent dark fringe.
(ii) $\beta=\dfrac{d}{\lambda D}$.
options.B:
(i) Fringe width is the distance between the central bright fringe and the first dark fringe.
(ii) $\beta=\dfrac{\lambda d}{D}$.
options.C:
(i) Fringe width is the distance between two consecutive bright fringes or two consecutive dark fringes.
(ii) $\beta=\dfrac{\lambda D}{d}$.
options.D:
(i) Fringe width is the total width of the diffraction pattern.
(ii) $\beta=\dfrac{D}{\lambda d}$.
